question: What are the top 5 items with the highest year-over-year growth percentage in total sales revenue for the year 2023?
sql:
WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as yr,
    SUM(sale_dollars) as total_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
    AND bottles_sold > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, yr
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue END) as rev_2022,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_revenue END) as rev_2023
  FROM yearly_sales
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  rev_2022,
  rev_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(rev_2023 - rev_2022, rev_2022) * 100 as yoy_growth_pct
FROM pivoted
WHERE rev_2022 IS NOT NULL AND rev_2022 > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
